user.title: Select operator
user.description: Choose your distribution operator. Kyiv oblast (KREM) and Kyiv city (KEM) have different operators.

city.title: Select city
city.description: Choose the city or settlement where your address is located.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check DTEK for outage updates. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Minimum 60 seconds, maximum 3600 seconds (1 hour).

connection.title: What would you like to connect?
connection.description: Address monitoring needs no login. The personal account is an independent connection, currently available only for Odessa in this preview.

account_login.title: Sign in to your personal account
account_login.description: Enter your +380… phone number and DTEK password. This connection only reads data. The password is stored in Home Assistant configuration. Reauthentication must use the same account.

accounts.title: Select personal accounts
accounts.description: Account data is not shared with the building Telegram bot. After setup, use Configure on this connection to add a separate building address. Data refreshes every 6 hours.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to DTEK website. Please try again later.
error.no_data: No data received from DTEK. Please try again later.
error.no_streets: No streets found for the selected city.
error.no_houses: No houses found for the selected street. You can enter the number manually.
error.invalid_city: City not found in the DTEK database. Please select from the list.
error.invalid_street: Street not found in the DTEK database. Please select from the list.
error.invalid_provider: This operator is not supported yet.
error.invalid_phone: Enter a Ukrainian phone number in +380… format.
error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials or complete any required account update on the DTEK website.
error.account_rate_limit: DTEK has limited requests. Wait before trying again.
error.account_cannot_connect: Cannot read the personal account service. Try again later.
error.no_accounts: No supported household accounts were found.
error.select_accounts: Select at least one available account.
error.invalid_house: Select a house confirmed by the public DTEK directory.
error.accounts_already_configured: One of these accounts is already connected. Select only accounts that have not been added.

abort.already_configured: This address or account is already configured.
abort.account_not_supported: Personal accounts are not supported for this operator yet.
abort.account_mismatch: Sign in to the same DTEK account.

init.title: Options
init.description: Update runtime settings for this DTEK address.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check DTEK for outage updates. Changes apply immediately after the integration reloads.

account.title: Add building monitoring
account.description: Choose an account address. A separate setup appears under Discovered on the integrations page. Verify its city, street and building; the apartment is not imported. Existing addresses are not duplicated. Configure the bot separately.

error.select_accounts: Select at least one available account.

abort.address_setup_started: Open the integrations page and complete the discovered DTEK address setup.
